> Yes this is a feature of our library, we already have some usage warning. Every widget should be very clear when used in a bad way: show the usage.

The type checking/tooling of React is very powerful, I don't think we want to recode anything here. I understand we have those "basic" usage exceptions but maybe we could just have a look if/how we could use the React propTypes tooling to benefit from all the features they have.
